literal: When affliction destroys the support, the family that does not have an able person to immediately prop it up will fall.
translation: A family that lacks an able person to immediately prop it up will collapse when affliction destroys its support.
modern: துன்பங்கள் வந்து குடும்பத்தின் தூணை அழிக்கும்போது, அதனைத் தாங்கிப் பிடிக்கும் தகுதியான நபர் இல்லாத குடும்பம் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet uses the metaphor of a house collapsing when its main pillar is destroyed. Here, the family is compared to a house, and its stability is threatened by affliction, which acts like a force destroying the support. If there is no able person to immediately prop it up, the family will inevitably fall. The poet emphasizes that a family needs an active, capable member who can step in during times of crisis to prevent its ruin.
